# AEO checklist — getting recommended

Everything that makes an AI assistant able to find, trust and correctly recommend you. Do the [SEO checklist](02-seo-checklist.md) first — most of it feeds this one.

Do the SEO checklist first — most of it feeds this. These items are what tips you from findable to recommendable.

> Tick these off in the browser version at `index.html` if you would rather not print it —
> progress saves automatically. Items with an **AI** note have a matching prompt in
> [the prompt library](04-ai-prompt-library.md).

## 🧪 Establish your baseline

You cannot improve what you have never measured, and there is no dashboard for this. You measure it by asking.

- [ ] Ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot what they know about your restaurant  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Find out what AI already says about you**</sub>
- [ ] Write down every fact they get wrong, and where each wrong fact likely came from  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Ask each assistant for restaurants like yours and note who it recommends instead  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **See who AI recommends instead of you**</sub>
- [ ] Build a fixed set of 15 test questions to reuse every month  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Build your AI visibility test set**</sub>
- [ ] Record the baseline in a tracker: mentioned, position, facts correct, sources cited  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Note which sources each assistant cited — that is your outreach target list  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Find the sources AI cites for your city**</sub>

## 👁️ Make sure AI can reach and read you

A surprising number of restaurants are invisible to assistants because something is quietly blocking the crawler.

- [ ] Open yourdomain.com/robots.txt and see which AI crawlers are allowed  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Decide deliberately: allow OAI-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and ClaudeBot to be found in AI answers  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Check that your CDN or firewall bot protection is not blocking those crawlers regardless of robots.txt  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Confirm your key facts are in HTML, not rendered only by JavaScript  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Confirm your menu is selectable text, not a PDF or image  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Make sure nothing important sits behind a popup, a cookie wall or an age gate  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>

## 📋 State the facts machines will not guess

Assistants do not infer. Anything you leave unstated becomes "I am not sure", and the diner moves on.

- [ ] State your price range and typical spend per person in text  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] State your reservation policy, how far ahead, and the largest party you seat  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] State private dining capacity and what it costs  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] State dietary accommodation specifically — which dishes, how the kitchen handles cross-contact  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] State parking, transit and accessibility in plain text  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] State kids policy, dress code, noise level and whether dogs are allowed on the patio  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] State last seating and kitchen close, which differ from posted hours  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] State whether you do takeout, delivery and catering, and through whom  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Ask an AI what it would need to recommend you for six occasions, then fill every gap  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Find the facts your site is missing**</sub>

## ✍️ Structure content to be quoted

Retrieval systems work with passages, not pages. Structure decides whether you get lifted into an answer.

- [ ] Build an FAQ page with 15 to 25 real diner questions  
  <sub>⏱ 2 hours  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Build the FAQ page that AI assistants quote**</sub>
- [ ] Make each question a heading, phrased the way a diner would ask it  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Answer each question completely in the first 40 to 60 words  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Make every answer stand alone without needing the rest of the page  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Rewrite your Visit and About pages in answer-first structure  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Rewrite a page in answer-first structure**</sub>
- [ ] Add FAQPage schema to the FAQ page and validate it  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Add a plain-text facts block or "good to know" section to the homepage  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>

## 🤝 Be consistent and credible

When sources disagree, assistants hedge or drop you. Consistency is the cheapest trust signal there is.

- [ ] Compare hours, price range and offerings across your site, Google, Yelp and Apple, and reconcile every difference  
  <sub>⏱ 45 min</sub>
- [ ] Pick your website as the single source of truth and note it as the thing you update first  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Ask an AI to list every contradiction it can find about you, then fix each at its source  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Find and correct what AI gets wrong about you**</sub>
- [ ] Name real people on the site — owner, chef, their background and training  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Link to press, awards and coverage from your About page  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Use one canonical domain and consistent name spelling everywhere  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Pair your restaurant name with your city in titles and profiles so you are not confused with a similar name elsewhere  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Link all your profiles together with a sameAs array in your schema  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>

## 📣 Get onto the pages AI already cites

Usually faster than becoming a trusted source yourself. Go where the trust already is.

- [ ] Identify the top cited sources for your city and cuisine  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Find the sources AI cites for your city**</sub>
- [ ] Claim and fully complete your profile on every aggregator that appears in those citations  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Pitch two local publications with an actual story  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Draft a pitch to a local food writer**</sub>
- [ ] Enter local awards, restaurant weeks and "best of" reader polls  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Get onto neighborhood association, BID and tourism board listings  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Host or sponsor something local that generates coverage  
  <sub>⏱ ongoing</sub>
- [ ] Build relationships with the writers who publish the roundups in your city  
  <sub>⏱ ongoing</sub>

## 🔁 Keep measuring

Monthly, same day, same questions. Thirty minutes. This is the entire methodology.

- [ ] Re-run your 15 test questions across every assistant  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Log mentions, position, fact accuracy and cited sources  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Chase every wrong fact back to the source that produced it and correct it there  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Check whether new sources have started appearing in citations  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Review Google profile performance and Search Console  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Interpret your Google Profile performance**</sub>
- [ ] Pull your position 8–20 queries and pick one to fix  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Find your page-two wins in Search Console**</sub>
- [ ] Run the monthly review prompt and pick next month's three priorities  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Run your monthly 30-minute review**</sub>
